# Ollama

> Ollama is a platform for running and integrating large language models locally with APIs, multi-platform support, and ecosystem integrations.

Ollama provides comprehensive documentation and tools for deploying open-source LLMs across macOS, Windows, and Linux. The platform emphasizes local model execution, API-first architecture, and seamless integration with popular development tools and workflows.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models
- Local Model Deployment
- API Configuration
- Installation & Setup
- Model Configuration
- Integrations
- Docker
- Python & JavaScript Libraries
- macOS, Windows, Linux
- Quickstart
- Workflow Automation
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Community Models
- Headless Mode
- Cloud Models

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart Guide](https://docs.ollama.com/quickstart): Quick start guide for Ollama installation on macOS, Windows, and Linux
- [Documentation Hub](https://docs.ollama.com): Main documentation for Ollama LLM setup, APIs, and community resources
- [Installation & Setup](https://ollama.com/docs): Documentation hub for Ollama with guides on installation, APIs, and LLM integration

## Integrations & Extensions

- [Integrations Overview](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations): Ollama integrations overview with coding agents, IDEs, and AI tools
- [OpenClaw Integration](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/openclaw): Guide to integrating OpenClaw with Ollama for messaging apps and AI assistants
- [Claude Code Integration](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/claude-code): Claude Code integration with Ollama for agentic coding and open models
- [Codex Integration](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/codex): Integration guide for Codex with Ollama setup and model configuration
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/n8n): n8n integration with Ollama for workflow automation and Docker deployment
- [Onyx RAG Integration](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/onyx): Onyx integration with Ollama for RAG, chat UI, and self-hosted deployment
